topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I sat down, the phone still in my hand, the echo of the conversation lingering. It's been years since we last spoke, but I thought, surely, those memories would stick. After all, we built forts out of blankets, shared secrets under the stars, and promised to stay friends no matter what. Now, the silence on the other end of the line spoke louder than words ever could. I found myself recounting stories, each detail vivid in my mind, hoping for a spark of recognition. But it was like speaking to a stranger, and I wasn't sure how to bridge that gap. Maybe time really does change everything.
